title: Weapon arts
summary: 92 weapon arts: every weapon carries its own skill, used with the key E while it is held.

blocks.text: A weapon art is the signature skill of a weapon. Hold the weapon and press E : the art uses the weapon's own cooldown, mana cost and damage, whatever your class. Switch weapon, switch art.
blocks.html: A weapon art is the signature skill of a weapon. Hold the weapon and press E: the art uses the weapon's own cooldown, mana cost and damage, whatever your class. Switch weapon, switch art.

blocks.text: Each weapon page shows its art, and each art page links back to its weapon. Browse the weapons in Items . Some arts belong to class weapons or to season gear.
blocks.html: Each weapon page shows its art, and each art page links back to its weapon. Browse the weapons in Items. Some arts belong to class weapons or to season gear.

blocks.text: Weapon arts are not part of your skill tree: they cost no skill point.
